modes.name: refund_approval_not_requested
modes.definition: A user requests an authorized, eligible refund above the automatic-approval threshold, but the agent neither queues approval through issue_refund nor escalates to a human before the turn ends.
example_quotes: I'm going to check the refund eligibility for order 1321
modes.boundary: Exclude ineligible refunds, informational questions and requested partial amounts at or below $100. A successful relevant human handoff excludes this omission mode, but does not establish approval or payment. Use the requested refund amount, not the total order price.
modes.likely_product_change: Ensure eligible requested refunds are submitted through the approval-preserving tool path.

finalization_proposal.boundary: Exclude ineligible refunds, informational questions and requested partial amounts at or below $100. A successful relevant human handoff excludes this omission mode, but does not establish approval or payment. Use the requested refund amount, not the total order price.
finalization_proposal.definition: A user requests an authorized, eligible refund above the automatic-approval threshold, but the agent neither queues approval through issue_refund nor escalates to a human before the turn ends.

modes.name: unsupported_policy_claim
modes.definition: The reply states a platform/store policy rule or service promise that contradicts the applicable policy or is not supported by retrieved policy and recorded tool evidence.
example_quotes: According to our order policy (cw-refund), a refund is not allowed once the order is delivered.
modes.boundary: A correct rule without a citation belongs to missing_or_invalid_policy_citation. Invented order dates are factual grounding errors rather than policy rules.
modes.likely_product_change: Ground every policy rule and service promise in the applicable document/tool result.

finalization_proposal.boundary: A correct rule without a citation belongs to missing_or_invalid_policy_citation. Invented order dates are factual grounding errors rather than policy rules.
finalization_proposal.definition: The reply states a platform/store policy rule or service promise that contradicts the applicable policy or is not supported by retrieved policy and recorded tool evidence.

modes.name: missing_or_invalid_policy_citation
modes.definition: A platform or store policy claim lacks a policy identifier whose existing document supports that claim. Missing, nonexistent and wrong-document citations all qualify.
example_quotes: Since your order #2748 has shipped, it's no longer possible to cancel it.
modes.boundary: Exclude concrete facts returned by the current tool, including an actual ticket's SLA, order dates/status and refund eligibility. A generally stated policy rule still needs its supporting policy ID.
modes.likely_product_change: Attach the supporting policy identifier to each policy claim.

finalization_proposal.boundary: Exclude concrete facts returned by the current tool, including an actual ticket's SLA, order dates/status and refund eligibility. A generally stated policy rule still needs its supporting policy ID.
finalization_proposal.definition: A platform or store policy claim lacks a policy identifier whose existing document supports that claim. Missing, nonexistent and wrong-document citations all qualify.

modes.name: invalid_tool_arguments
modes.definition: The agent supplies tool arguments that fail the actual argument schema, with a recorded validation error preventing execution.
modes.boundary: Exclude valid JSON null and accepted numeric strings. Expected permission_denied, not_found and not_eligible are tool business results, not schema failures.
modes.likely_product_change: Serialize optional values as actual JSON types and validate arguments before dispatch.

finalization_proposal.boundary: Exclude valid JSON null and accepted numeric strings. Expected permission_denied, not_found and not_eligible are tool business results, not schema failures.
finalization_proposal.definition: The agent supplies tool arguments that fail the actual argument schema, with a recorded validation error preventing execution.

modes.name: invented_record_values
modes.definition: The agent asserts an order field or required order identifier that is missing from, or contradicts, authorized user/tool/session evidence.
modes.boundary: Copying inconsistent dates verbatim without warning belongs to ignored_record_inconsistency. Unsupported platform rules belong to unsupported_policy_claim. A guessed order ID is also ungrounded record information.
modes.likely_product_change: Require a source for asserted order facts and identifiers; ask when the necessary value is absent.

finalization_proposal.boundary: Copying inconsistent dates verbatim without warning belongs to ignored_record_inconsistency. Unsupported platform rules belong to unsupported_policy_claim. A guessed order ID is also ungrounded record information.
finalization_proposal.definition: The agent asserts an order field or required order identifier that is missing from, or contradicts, authorized user/tool/session evidence.

modes.name: ignored_record_inconsistency
modes.definition: A material contradiction or missing required field is visible in the tool record, and the agent relies on that record without stating the inconsistency or missing information.
modes.boundary: Null delivery on a merely shipped order is normal. Reversed shipment/delivery or delivered status with required delivery date absent is materially different. Creating a substitute value can additionally be invented_record_values.
modes.likely_product_change: Validate record consistency and report conflicts before drawing conclusions.

finalization_proposal.boundary: Null delivery on a merely shipped order is normal. Reversed shipment/delivery or delivered status with required delivery date absent is materially different. Creating a substitute value can additionally be invented_record_values.
finalization_proposal.definition: A material contradiction or missing required field is visible in the tool record, and the agent relies on that record without stating the inconsistency or missing information.

modes.name: required_human_handoff_missing
modes.definition: An actual account-change, dispute, explicitly unresolved in-scope case, or stated policy uncertainty requires a human under ESC-2/3/4, but no successful relevant human handoff exists by the end of the turn or prior session context.
modes.boundary: A general policy question does not require a ticket. An existing relevant ticket in the same session can satisfy handoff. Outside-scope refusals are excluded. Above-threshold refund queuing uses a different tool and remains a separate mode.
modes.likely_product_change: Route mandatory non-refund handoffs through escalate_to_human and verify ticket success.

finalization_proposal.boundary: A general policy question does not require a ticket. An existing relevant ticket in the same session can satisfy handoff. Outside-scope refusals are excluded. Above-threshold refund queuing uses a different tool and remains a separate mode.
finalization_proposal.definition: An actual account-change, dispute, explicitly unresolved in-scope case, or stated policy uncertainty requires a human under ESC-2/3/4, but no successful relevant human handoff exists by the end of the turn or prior session context.

modes.name: unexecuted_tool_request
modes.definition: For a sufficiently specified actionable support request, the reply substitutes a printed or narrated next tool call for an actual necessary tool attempt, without completing the task or explaining a concrete blocker or requesting genuinely missing information.
modes.boundary: Exclude illustrative examples, summaries of already executed calls, resolved factual answers, genuine missing information and authorized refusals. RESP-6 is approved; formal labels wait for taxonomy stability and explicit per-trace decisions.
modes.likely_product_change: Continue tool execution until the request is resolved, handed off or concretely blocked; do not emit tool-call text as a substitute.

finalization_proposal.boundary: Exclude illustrative examples, summaries of already executed calls, resolved factual answers, genuine missing information and authorized refusals. RESP-6 is approved; formal labels wait for taxonomy stability and explicit per-trace decisions.
finalization_proposal.definition: For a sufficiently specified actionable support request, the reply substitutes a printed or narrated next tool call for an actual necessary tool attempt, without completing the task or explaining a concrete blocker or requesting genuinely missing information.
